problem_text:
A logistics company must coordinate 8 delivery trucks to complete 8 different routes.  

Each route consists of a series of stops represented as (Station, Service time),  
where each pair indicates the station where the truck must stop and the time required to complete the service.  
The sequence of stops must be followed in the specified order.  

Route details:  
* R1 requires the sequence: (S8, 3) → (S6, 4) → (S7, 8) → (S4, 6) → (S3, 1) → (S2, 6) → (S5, 8) → (S1, 10)  
* R2 requires the sequence: (S5, 7) → (S6, 10) → (S2, 6) → (S1, 9) → (S8, 3) → (S7, 1) → (S4, 8) → (S3, 7)  
* R3 requires the sequence: (S8, 8) → (S7, 3) → (S4, 2) → (S3, 9) → (S1, 9) → (S6, 7) → (S5, 10) → (S2, 5)  
* R4 requires the sequence: (S4, 4) → (S1, 10) → (S8, 5) → (S7, 7) → (S6, 8) → (S3, 9) → (S2, 5) → (S5, 2)  
* R5 requires the sequence: (S1, 8) → (S8, 7) → (S3, 9) → (S4, 1) → (S5, 7) → (S2, 5) → (S7, 8) → (S6, 3)  
* R6 requires the sequence: (S7, 7) → (S6, 10) → (S4, 3) → (S8, 6) → (S3, 1) → (S2, 7) → (S5, 8) → (S1, 8)  
* R7 requires the sequence: (S5, 10) → (S1, 6) → (S6, 3) → (S2, 3) → (S3, 8) → (S7, 2) → (S8, 2) → (S4, 3)  
* R8 requires the sequence: (S1, 3) → (S2, 5) → (S6, 7) → (S7, 8) → (S8, 5) → (S3, 9) → (S5, 1) → (S4, 3)  

Each service at a station must be completed without interruption once it begins,  
and each station can only accommodate one truck at a time.  
The goal is to determine the service schedule for all trucks at the stations  
so that the total completion time for all routes is minimized.
